# SOP-P3-L2-01 Line startup - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, EQ-P3-L2-HT03  
Related: ECN-2026-044, MM-P3-L2-RR02, SOP-P3-L2-03

Preconditions
1. All maintenance activities referenced in MM-P3-L2-RR02 and ECN-2026-044 are completed and signed off.
2. All interlocks and safety systems are functional and cleared for startup.
3. Material staging is verified per SOP-P3-L2-03.

PPE
1. Safety glasses.
2. Cut-resistant gloves.
3. Hearing protection.
4. Steel-toe footwear.

Startup Procedure
1. Visual inspection: Walk the conveyance and shot blast areas on EQ-P3-L2-SB01 and EQ-P3-L2-RR02. Confirm no foreign objects or loose hardware are present.
2. Fastener verification: Check the blast wheel liner bolts on EQ-P3-L2-SB01. Confirm the blast wheel liner bolt torque for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is 100 N·m and that torque verification is recorded on the inspection form.
3. Lubrication: Verify lubricants installed on EQ-P3-L2-SB01 match CFW-LUB-463. Record lubricant part number for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is CFW-LUB-463 in the lubrication log.
4. Utilities: Confirm compressed air, electrical supply, and cooling are in normal operating state. Observe for abnormal noises or leaks.
5. Control power: Enable control power to EQ-P3-L2-RR02 and EQ-P3-L2-HT03 at the operator panel. Monitor for any alarms.
6. Dry run: Execute a dry run with no load on EQ-P3-L2-RR02 using operator interface. Verify motion profiles and interlock responses.
7. First-piece verification: Introduce first piece per SOP-P3-L2-03. Inspect rolled ring for dimensional and surface acceptance.
8. Stabilization: Monitor process until parameters are steady and within expected ranges. Use MM-P3-L2-RR02 for reference checks.

Deviations
1. Any alarm or abnormal condition requires immediate stop and notification to maintenance and supervision.

Sign-off
1. Operator name and signature:
2. Shift supervisor name and signature:
3. Maintenance verifier name and signature:
